description.email: The e-mails the platform sends, in Arabic and English. Change the wording and the colors (brand colors only). Type @ in the text to insert a value the platform fills in, such as the person's name.
description.notification: The notices the platform sends (the bell and the e-mail copy), in Arabic and English. Type @ in the text to insert a value the platform fills in, such as the task number.

saved.live: Saved. The new wording is in use.
saved.submitted: Sent for approval. The current wording stays until someone else approves.
saved.approved: Approved. The new wording is in use.

reset.title: Go back to the default wording?
reset.description: Your wording for this message (and any change waiting for approval) is discarded. The default is sent from now on.

approval.label: A second person must approve changes
approval.hint: When on, a saved change waits until someone other than its author approves it; until then the current wording is sent.
approval.active: Changes wait for a second person's approval before they are used.
approval.on: Approval by a second person is on.
approval.off: Approval by a second person is off.

pending.banner: A change by {{name}} is waiting for approval; you are editing it.
pending.ownChange: You made this change, so someone else must approve it.

fields.subject: Subject
fields.title: Title
fields.preheaderHint: The short line mail apps show beside the subject.
fields.buttonHint: The button opens the link. Leave it empty for no button.

variables.title: Values the platform fills in
variables.hint: Type @ in the text and pick one. Only these can be used.
